thread:
Alex R: Hey team — Heidi from CloudPartner is asking to sync on AP-Southwest region launch. Main asks: marketplace SKU entitlements, GPU quota (A100/80GB), KMS key setup for EU/SEA data residency, and a coordinated announcement window. Can ops/legal chime in?
Heidi (CloudPartner): Thanks Alex! We can greenlight 20 reserved A100s initially. Need Redwood to submit marketplace entitlement form + expected go-live date. Also we need a contact for KMS key rotation policy.
Maria S: tagging @Dawn S for KMS/compliance. For entitlements, we usually request 2 steps: (1) partner marketplace listing update, (2) region SKU mapping + quota request. I can own the entitlement form. ETA EOD Thu for the draft.
Dawn S: KMS note — for AP-Southwest we'll require a regional key and rotation window aligned with partner policy. Can you share the partner's key length / HSM requirements? Also any PII residency requirements?
Heidi (CloudPartner): HSM yes, we use AWS CloudHSM currently. No additional PII constraints beyond regional residency for logs. Rotation every 90 days acceptable.
Jamal K: Ops side — GPU quota inbound: request will need exact SKU codes. Heidi can you confirm the marketplace SKU ids for A100-80GB and any lower-tier fallback (e.g., A10, T4) for burst?
Heidi (CloudPartner): SKU ids: cp-a100-80gb-prod, cp-a10-40gb-burst, cp-t4-16gb-burst. We'll allow bursting to A10 for non-SLA traffic.
Maria S: Draft entitlement payload I'm going to submit to marketplace portal — dropping sample below:
```json
{
  "partner": "CloudPartner",
  "region": "ap-southwest-1",
  "skus": ["cp-a100-80gb-prod","cp-a10-40gb-burst"],
  "reserved_capacity": 20,
  "burst_policy": "a10,t4",
  "go_live_date": "2026-05-12"
}
```
Alex R: Analytics/product question — are we comfortable with 20 reserved GPUs for initial customers? Forecast from growth shows 30% chance of exceeding in month 1. If we need to scale, what's partner lead time?
Heidi (CloudPartner): Lead time for additional commit is ~7 business days for capacity reallocation in that region. Short-term bursts are fine.
Dawn S: Legal/compliance ok with the rotation policy and regional key. Need a short MSA addendum for data residency to sign before go-live. Sending template for review.
PartnerOpsBot: marketplace-submission: submission_id=msub-20260301-452; status=review_pending; reviewer=marketplace-team@cloudpartner.com
Maria S: Thanks bot. I'll track. Quick ask: do we want a joint press window? Partner suggests two-week embargo before public announcement so we can validate scaling under load tests. Proposed announce date: 2026-05-26. Thoughts?
Alex R: Two-week embargo sounds right. Plan: internal load test 2026-05-06 to 05-10, entitlements approved by 05-12, announce 05-26. Assignments: Maria owns entitlement form + marketplace follow-up, Dawn handles KMS + legal addendum, Jamal owns capacity validation/runbook, Heidi coordinates partner side.
Heidi (CloudPartner): Copy. We'll also run partner-side canary on 05-08. I'll send calendar invites.
Jamal K: I'll schedule the canary load window and share minimal runbook snippet here — basic check: 95th p90 latency < 220ms, sustained token throughput target 1.2M tokens/hour, fallback to A10 should not exceed 25% of traffic.
Alex R: Perfect. One more: marketing needs a short blurb for co-announcement. Heidi, can you drop a 2-line partner-ready blurb here by Tue?
Heidi (CloudPartner): Will do.
Maria S: Filing follow-up checklist: entitlement form submitted (msub-20260301-452), KMS addendum draft pending, capacity booked 20 reserved, marketing blurb pending, legal addendum pending. I'll update this thread with links to docs as they come in. :thumbsup:
Alex R: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, call it out here or ping me directly.
Dawn S: Uploaded MSA addendum draft to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/partners/ap-sw-msa-draft
Maria S: Marketplace review moved to 'approved' by partner reviewer — status update: approved 2026-03-02 10:14 UTC.
PartnerOpsBot: deployment-schedule: canary-window=2026-05-08T10:00Z-2026-05-08T14:00Z; notify=#eng-runtime #eng-sre
Alex R: Great, locking dates. Will set a reminder for the announcement coordination two weeks prior.
Heidi (CloudPartner): Thanks all — excited to get this live. :rocket:
